description: This file defines a React component for customizing a toolbar within the Notesnook application. It includes drag-and-drop functionality for reordering toolbar items, managing presets, and handling toolbar groups and items.

methods.name: TreeNodeComponent
methods.description: Renders individual toolbar group or item, with drag-and-drop handles and optional remove/add buttons.

methods.name: SortableWrapper
methods.description: Wraps toolbar items to make them sortable via drag-and-drop, handling visual states and actions.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Converts nested toolbar group definitions into a flat list of TreeNode objects with depth info.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Converts a flat list of TreeNode objects back into nested toolbar group definitions.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new toolbar group node with default or specified properties.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a new toolbar item node with specified toolId and properties.

methods.name: createTrash
methods.description: Creates a special group node representing the trash/disabled tools area.

methods.name: moveGroup
methods.description: Moves a toolbar group within the list, respecting nesting rules.

methods.name: canMoveGroup
methods.description: Checks if a group can be moved to a target location based on nesting constraints.

methods.name: moveItem
methods.description: Moves a toolbar item within the list, adjusting depth and position.

methods.name: removeGroup
methods.description: Removes a group and moves its items to the trash or another group.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item and moves it to the trash group.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a toolbar item should be collapsed based on the active selection.

methods.name: isSubgroup
methods.description: Type guard to check if a TreeNode is a subgroup.

methods.name: isGroup
methods.description: Type guard to check if a TreeNode is a group.

methods.name: isItem
methods.description: Type guard to check if a TreeNode is an item.

methods.name: isTrash
methods.description: Checks if a TreeNode is the trash group.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if an item is in the trash group.

methods.name: getItemGroup
methods.description: Finds the group or subgroup that an item belongs to.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Finds a group or subgroup by ID and returns its range of items.

methods.name: addSubGroup
methods.description: Adds a new subgroup inside a specified group.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a new top-level group, optionally near the trash group.

methods.name: getDisabledTools
methods.description: Returns a list of tools that are not currently enabled in the toolbar.
